name: labs/jasegehring__spamb
title: SPAMB syringe pump (Chemyx Fusion 4000-X, PumpController)
intro: SPAMB syringe pump (Chemyx Fusion 4000-X, PumpController), adapted from jasegehring/spamb. It reads `running`, `dispensed_volume` and `volume_remaining`; sets `direction`, `flow_rate`, `target_volume` and `syringe_diameter`; runs `run_pump` and `stop_pump`. `run_pump`: run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/jasegehring__spamb --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/jasegehring__spamb --backend fake --mcp
